purpose: Teach: 祖先/生前/独断/戦死/胎児/判別/二酸化炭素/裁定

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、われわれの祖先の遺伝子研究を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Sakura, your paper was on ancestral genetic research, wasn't it?
lines.style: Warm curiosity. Gentle opening, as if checking in on something already discussed. Steady eye contact. Patient—no rush. The tone of a teacher who remembers what matters to her students.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、生前の意思を尊重する制度を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I focused on policies around respecting people's wishes before death.
lines.style: Clear and direct. Slight lift at the start—answering a teacher she respects. Measured pace. Precise, like she's thought through exactly what she wanted to say. No apology in the tone.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 独断的な指導者を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: And you looked at authoritarian leadership patterns, didn't you?
lines.style: Gentle probe. Not accusatory—reflective. Slight pause before the question mark, as if thinking aloud alongside her. Warm but attentive. Testing whether she'll connect the threads.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、戦死者を悼む制度を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—specifically how societies memorialize those lost in war.
lines.style: Steady voice. The cadence of someone who can explain the logic behind their choices. Confident without being defensive. A beat of weight on the final phrase.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 胎児の発達研究を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Your fetal development research—that was interesting too.
lines.style: Observant, encouraging. Slight lilt that invites her to say more. The opening is warm, then settles into genuine curiosity about her work. Doesn't lead, just opens the door.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、AIによる音声判別技術を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I actually explored AI voice recognition technology and its applications.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact clarity. A touch of confidence in her correction. She's steering the conversation gently back to what she actually did. No frustration, just precision.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 二酸化炭素削減の研究を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: And CO2 reduction was one of your focuses?
lines.style: Reflective tone, slightly tentative. As if mentally reviewing notes. Quiet attentiveness. Pauses slightly before the question, giving space. Genuinely interested in whether this threads back to something.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、国際法廷の裁定について論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I wrote about international court decisions and their precedents.
lines.style: Final statement. Clear, composed, and complete. She's answered thoroughly. Slight settling at the end, as if closing a door gently. Confident but not rushed.
